name: T9 SciFact first-command-only retrieval test
split: official public dev split, newly held out for this project; official native test has no public gold
corpus: all native corpus.jsonl abstracts, title plus every abstract sentence; no claims, evidence, labels or cited_doc_ids indexed
query: native claim verbatim only; no supplied title, document ID, cited_doc_ids, query translation or document filter
selection: all native dev claims with nonempty native evidence; no sampling; invalid native references stop before first query rather than dropping cases
evidence_primary: at least one complete native rationale sentence set from any annotated evidence document; SUPPORT and CONTRADICT both count as relevant evidence, not a prediction that the claim is true
secondary: all annotated documents have at least one complete native rationale returned; document recall separately diagnostic
no_evidence_claims: reported as outside the gold-evidence retrieval denominator; not scored as successes and not used for tuning
latency_goal: all actual successful search_docs RPC first calls below10s; startup/build/grading separate
build_profile: unchanged installed explicit-English Intel-GPU quickstart model profile; token-aware sections1000/100,ANN,facets-v3,section-gaps-v3
reserve_note: new small standalone test preflight reserves10GB; previous T8 protocol unchanged; no old artifacts deleted
notes: pre-query publication; retrieval uses only public build and serve commands, private scripts acquire/format data and grade saved outputs
